correctness.rationale: Each F_k is homogeneous degree10 and vanishes on all 57 F7 projective points. The rational-singularity criterion excludes k=0,2,4,5,6; independently computed Groebner bases of three projective-gradient ideals on each of X=1,Y=1,Z=1 for k=1 and 3, all six contain 1, proving geometric smoothness (not just F7-point smoothness). Degree-genus formula gives g=36. I independently expanded F_k^6 mod7, constructed 36x36 Hasse–Witt coefficient matrices indexed degree7 triples, computed ranks A=rank(A²)=35 for both, giving a=1 and p-rank35. Polarization forces remaining height-two Newton slopes 1/2 each. Independent exhaustive F49 normalized-point enumeration using u²=3 yields affine counts 95,99 plus 8 infinity points, hence totals 103,107. Their Weil second zeta coefficients differ, so F7 Jacobians cannot be isogenous. Exact finite-field computations are exhaustive for stated field, not extrapolations.
